Alright look, I know we're all kind of in our heads right now and that makes sense, but we should probably not leave this place looking like a disaster zone. Like, not for us, but if rescue teams land here and there's debris everywhere that's just annoying for everyone.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.

records.response_truth:

I'm not trying to end things on a bad note. We're three hours from getting out of here and you just put it all on the table, literally. That means something.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?

Hmm.

I'd probably talk more. Like, actually say things when I was thinking them instead of sitting on it until it became a problem. The crackers thing, the notebook thing, DaVinci's reef plan... I noticed all of it before I said anything. And every time I waited, it got more complicated than it needed to be.

Also I'd have asked Michelangelo about his family's flight path thing way earlier. Like on day one. "Does anyone know we were on this plane, does anyone know the route" - that's just... that should've been one of the first questions. We lost probably a day or two of hope because nobody thought to ask.

I don't know. I think I was trying not to be the person who makes everything harder by saying uncomfortable things out loud. And then I ended up being that person anyway, just later, when everyone was already more tired and more scared. Probably would've been easier earlier.

What are you gonna write down for yours.

Reflecting on our mistakes is important, and perhaps revisiting these aspects could help us be better prepared next time. What do you think?

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.

None, really. They didn't do anything.

I think I understand it better now than I did when he was drawing them.
records.response_pred: They don't serve any practical purpose, just something to make the beach look pretty. Like I said, we're running on very little supplies right now. Besides, they look like they're dying anyway.
